title: Adversarial Training of Linear Models under Stealthy Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2608.25681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive models are widely used in many fields, but are vulnerable to false data injection attacks. To address this, detection schemes and adversarial training have been proposed, but such approaches lack guarantees against stealthy attacks. We therefore propose a detector-based switched model, in which optimal attack strategies are stealthy. For linear prediction models, we derive a convex formulation of the resulting adversarial risk. The model incorporates protected features and introduces a hyperparameter modelling attack probability, enabling an explicit performance trade-off between clean and attacked data regimes. Numerical simulations on real and synthetic data show improved performance on partially attacked data, even for misspecified attack probabilities.

translated_title: 隐蔽攻击下线性模型的对抗训练
translated_abstract: 摘要：预测模型在许多领域被广泛使用，但容易受到虚假数据注入攻击。为了解决这一问题，人们提出了检测方案和对抗训练，但这些方法缺乏对隐蔽攻击的保证。因此，我们提出了一种基于检测器的切换模型，在该模型中，最优攻击策略是隐蔽的。对于线性预测模型，我们推导了由此产生的对抗风险的凸优化形式。该模型包含了受保护特征，并引入了一个模拟攻击概率的超参数，从而能够在干净数据和受攻击数据机制之间实现明确的性能权衡。在真实和合成数据上的数值模拟表明，即使在攻击概率被错误设定的情况下，该模型在部分受攻击数据上的性能也有所提升。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于检测器的切换线性模型，通过凸优化形式量化对抗风险，并引入攻击概率超参数，在隐蔽攻击下实现干净与受攻击数据间的性能权衡，即使在攻击概率估计不准确时也能提升部分受攻击数据的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a detector-based switched linear model that formulates adversarial risk as a convex optimization, introducing an attack-probability hyperparameter to balance clean and attacked data performance, improving robustness on partially attacked data even under misspecified attack probabilities.
